title: Armrest comfort and heating expectations
summary: Feedback on armrests and adjacent knee-contact areas centers on requests for heated or softer touchpoints alongside a few favorable comments about armrest positioning and materials, while many fragments are too brief or descriptive to show clear sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews mention a well-positioned driver armrest and appreciation for softer leather on knee-rest areas.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews include suggestions or factual mentions about wider or heated door and center armrests, controls on the armrest, and one fragment that is too unclear to interpret.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are undetermined, which limits confidence about overall customer sentiment on this topic.
The cluster mixes comfort requests, feature expectations, and simple control-location descriptions rather than a single clearly defined issue.
One fragment is too unclear to interpret reliably.
